commitResults.messageTitle: Keep pasted tabs and line breaks visible in the command box
commitResults.messageBody:
A JavaFX text field silently drops control characters from pasted text,
so "sample<TAB>load" became "sampleload" and two pasted lines ran
together into a different command. The command box now shows a pasted
tab as a space, each LF, CR or CRLF as a visible marker and any other
control character as a second marker. It records where it inserted each
marker, so on Enter only those become line breaks again: the parser
rejects the command with the single-line message and the text stays for
correction, while the same symbols typed as text stay text.

ControlCharacterMarkersTest covers the conversions, position tracking
and parser outcome. MvpAcceptance pastes a tab, an LF, a CRLF and a
vertical tab into the real command box and searches for a typed marker.

commitResults.messageTitle: Exclude runtime logs from packaged JARs
commitResults.messageBody:
Non-clean builds can copy runtime log files from the compiled class directory into the distributed JAR. This can expose local execution data and make release contents depend on earlier runs.
